voices.name: editorial
voices.role: display phrase, poetic title, intimate statement

voices.name: calligraphic
voices.role: the character is an object, not a caption

rules: Default invented display text is a short Chinese observation (object + visible state), never an English slogan and never a stock blessing reused across unrelated outputs.
Preserve user-supplied wording exactly; do not translate unless asked.
Calligraphic variants may keep brush glyphs in-image; precise multi-line Chinese still prefers type-off.
One dramatic scale jump. No gradient type, outline, drop shadow, or 3D inflated letters.
